releases.title: Version 1.1.0
notes: 22 more languages, so it now comes in 23: Czech, Danish, German, Spanish, Estonian, Finnish, French, Croatian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Brazilian…
Config.Locale = 'auto', the new default: it follows ox_lib's language (setr ox:locale "de" in server.cfg) and is English when that isn't set. A config that already says 'en' stays in English.

releases.title: Version 1.0.1
notes: Links, badges and the update checker's registry address now point to the Pigeon Studios GitHub organisation, pigeon-studios-uk. Old WelshPigeon links still redirect, and copies already installed…

releases.title: First release
notes: Reports properties nobody has used for a set number of days to Discord.
Supports NoLag Properties and Qbox properties, detected automatically.
Early warnings, and each property reported once per stretch of inactivity.
Owner and keyholder names, a staff command, and exports for other resources.
